2.Name: Alert
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: Alert
metadata:
    cluster: cluster
    name: alert
spec:
    connectName: connect
    connectorName: connector
    metric: FailedTaskCount
    operator: GreaterThan
    threshold: 1
    type: KafkaConnectAlert

3.Name: Alert
3.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v3
kind: Alert
metadata:
    appInstance: my-app
    name: alert
spec:
    cluster: cluster
    connectName: connect
    connectorName: connector
    destination:
        channel: test
        type: Slack
    metric: FailedTaskCount
    operator: GreaterThan
    threshold: 1
    type: KafkaConnectAlert

1.Name: Application
1.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Application
metadata:
    labels:
        business-unit: delivery
    name: my-application
spec:
    owner: me
    policyRef:
        - my-policy
    title: My Application

1.Name: ApplicationGroup
1.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ApplicationGroup
metadata:
    application: clickstream-app
    name: clickstream-support
spec:
    description: |-
        Members of the Support Group are allowed:
        Read access on all the resources
        Can restart owned connectors
        Can reset offsets
    displayName: Support Clickstream
    externalGroupRegex:
        - support*
    externalGroups:
        - support
    instancePermissions:
        - appInstance: clickstream-app-dev
          permissions:
            - instanceViewConfig
    members:
        - user1@company.org
        - user2@company.org
    permissions:
        - appInstance: clickstream-app-dev
          name: '*'
          patternType: LITERAL
          permissions:
            - topicConsume
            - topicViewConfig
          resourceType: TOPIC

1.Name: ApplicationInstance
1.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ApplicationInstance
metadata:
    application: my-app
    labels:
        env: prod
        team: my-team
    name: my-app-instance-prod
spec:
    cluster: prod-cluster
    defaultCatalogVisibility: PUBLIC
    policyRef:
        - my-policy
    resources:
        - name: my-topic
          patternType: LITERAL
          type: TOPIC
        - name: my-consumer-group
          patternType: LITERAL
          type: CONSUMER_GROUP
    serviceAccount: my-service-account
    topicPolicyRef:
        - my-topic-policy

1.Name: ApplicationInstancePermission
1.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ApplicationInstancePermission
metadata:
    appInstance: test
    application: test
    name: test
spec:
    grantedTo: test
    resource:
        name: test
        patternType: LITERAL
        type: TOPIC
    serviceAccountPermission: WRITE
    userPermission: READ

2.Name: Connector
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: Connector
metadata:
    autoRestart:
        enabled: true
        frequencySeconds: 600
    cluster: my-cluster
    connectCluster: my-connect
    description: My connector
    name: my-connector
spec:
    config: {}

2.Name: ConnectorTemplate
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: ConnectorTemplate
metadata:
    labels:
        category: sink
    name: s3-sink-standard
spec:
    defaults:
        metadata:
            labels:
                category: sink
            name: s3-sink-${dept}
        spec:
            class: io.confluent.connect.s3.S3SinkConnector
            config:
                flush.size: "10000"
                format.class: io.confluent.connect.s3.format.avro.AvroFormat
                rotate.interval.ms: "60000"
                storage.class: io.confluent.connect.s3.storage.S3Storage
                tasks.max: "2"
    description: Standard S3 sink connector with flush every 10,000 records or 60 seconds.
    displayName: S3 Sink (Standard)

1.Name: DataQualityPolicy
1.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: DataQualityPolicy
metadata:
    group: my-group
    name: my-policy
spec:
    actions:
        block:
            enabled: true
        dlq:
            dlqTopic: my-dlq-topic
            enabled: true
        mark:
            enabled: true
    description: My policy description
    displayName: My policy
    rules:
        - my-rule
    targets:
        - cluster: my-cluster1
          patternType: LITERAL
          topic: topic
        - cluster: my-cluster2
          patternType: PREFIXED
          topic: topic-*

1.Name: DataQualityRule
1.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: DataQualityRule
metadata:
    name: my-rule
spec:
    celExpression: value.user == 'admin'
    description: Allow only admin
    displayName: Admin only
    type: Cel

2.Name: GlueSchema
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: GlueSchema
metadata:

spec:

2.Name: Group
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: Group
metadata:
    name: group
spec:
    description: description
    displayName: test
    externalGroupRegex:
        - tes*
    externalGroups:
        - test

          permissions:
            - topicConsume

2.Name: KafkaCluster
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: KafkaCluster
metadata:
    labels:
        env: prod
    name: my-kafka-cluster
spec:
    bootstrapServers: localhost:9092
    color: '#FF0000'
    displayName: yo
    icon: icon
    properties:
        sasl.jaas.config: org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required username="admin" password="admin-secret";
    schemaRegistry:
        ignoreUntrustedCertificate: false
        security:
            password: admin-secret
            type: BasicAuth
            username: admin
        type: ConfluentLike
        url: https://my-schema-registry:8081

2.Name: PartnerZone
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: PartnerZone
metadata:
    labels:
        project: projectA
    name: john-partner-zone
spec:
    authenticationMode:
        serviceAccount: johndoe
        type: PLAIN
    cluster: my-gateway
    description: for john
    displayName: John's partner zone
    headers:
        addOnProduce:
            - key: X-My-Header
              overrideIfExists: false
              value: my-x-value
            - key: Y-My-Header
              overrideIfExists: true
              value: my-y-value
        removeOnConsume:
            - keyRegex: my_org_prefix.*
    partner:
        email: johndoe@company.io
        name: John Doe
        phone: 07827 837 177
        role: Data analyst
    topics:
        - backingTopic: kafka-topic-a
          name: topic-a
          permission: WRITE
    trafficControlPolicies:
        limitCommitOffset: 30
        maxConsumeRate: 2000000
        maxProduceRate: 1000000
    underlyingCluster: my-cluster
    url: http://conduktor.io
    vclusterName: johns-vcluster

1.Name: ResourcePolicy
1.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourcePolicy
metadata:
    labels:
        business-unit: delivery
    name: example
spec:
    description: A policy for a Connect to check that we always set the key 'a' to 1 and the key 'name' to 'example'
    rules:
        - condition: spec.a == 1
          errorMessage: a should be 1
        - condition: metadata.name == 'example'
          errorMessage: name should be example
    targetKind: Connector

1.Name: ServiceAccount
1.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
    appInstance: my-app-instance-dev
    cluster: my-kafka-cluster
    labels:
        conduktor.io/application: application-a
        conduktor.io/application-instance: dev
        user-labels: I am a user label
    name: sa-clicko-dev
spec:
    authorization:
        acls:
            - host: '*'
              name: click.
              operations:
                - Write
              patternType: PREFIXED
              permission: Allow
              type: TOPIC
        type: KAFKA_ACL
    schemaRegistryAuthorization:
        acls:
            - name: click.
              operations:
                - Read
                - Write
              patternType: PREFIXED

2.Name: Topic
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: Topic

1.ApplyExample:

spec:
    policies:
        my-policy:
            constraint: OneOf
            optional: true
            values:
                - value1
                - value2

2.Name: TopicTemplate
2.ApplyExample:
apiVersion: v2
kind: TopicTemplate
metadata:
    labels:
        category: template
    name: high-partition-topic
spec:
    defaults:
        metadata:
            labels:
                throughput: high
            name: my-topic-${department}
        spec:
            configs:
                cleanup.policy: delete
                min.insync.replicas: "2"
                retention.ms: "604800000"
            partitions: 24
            replicationFactor: 3
    description: Optimised for high-throughput workloads. 24 partitions, 3× replication, 7-day retention.
    displayName: High Partition Topic
